model.title: Transport: enforcement of passenger rights in the Union

summary.text: This proposal aims to strengthen how passenger rights are enforced across Europe's transport systems. It seeks to ensure that travelers have better protection and clearer ways to claim compensation when things go wrong with their journeys.
